subject: ela
intro: Command of textual evidence (SAT R&W style).

items.prompt: Evidence must directly support the ____ stated in the question.

Claim: 'The park is popular.' Best support?
(A) visits rose 60% (B) it has trees (C) it opened in 2001
Evidence about the topic but not the claim is ____.

Claim: 'The drug reduces fever.' Best support?
(A) patients' fevers dropped (B) the pill is blue (C) it is cheap
Some SAT items ask which finding ____ a claim.

Claim: 'Reading daily builds vocabulary.' Best support?
(A) daily readers scored higher on vocab tests (B) books are heavy (C) libraries are quiet

Claim: 'The bridge is unsafe.' Weakening evidence?
(A) recent inspection found no defects (B) it is old (C) it is long
The best evidence connects specifically to the ____.

Claim: 'Exercise improves sleep.' Best support?
(A) exercisers reported deeper sleep (B) gyms are busy (C) running is hard
A fun fact unrelated to the claim is a ____ trap.

Claim: 'The policy cut traffic.' Best support?
(A) car counts fell 30% (B) the law is new (C) roads are wide
Supporting evidence makes the claim more ____.

Claim: 'The species is recovering.' Best support?
(A) its numbers have risen for five years (B) it is small (C) it is rare
Always match the evidence to the exact ____ asked.
